rule.description: AI or agent tool process started
rule.info: Detects process creation for common AI tools, agentic coding tools, local LLM applications, and MCP server binaries.
Falsepositives: Approved AI tools installed and managed by IT.

rule.description: AI or agent tool executed from user Downloads, Desktop, or Temp path
rule.info: Detects portable or unmanaged AI tooling launched from common user-controlled locations.
Falsepositives: Approved portable testing by admins or developers.

rule.description: AI or agent tool executed from user developer or package-manager path
rule.info: Detects AI tools launched from npm, Python virtualenv, source, repo, or user-local program paths.
Falsepositives: Normal developer activity in approved environments.

rule.description: Node package runner started AI or MCP tooling
rule.info: Detects npm/npx/pnpm/yarn/bun based execution of AI tools, coding agents, SDK clients, or MCP servers.
Falsepositives: Approved package installation, build scripts, or AI-enabled development workflows.

rule.description: Python package runner started AI or MCP tooling
rule.info: Detects Python and uv based execution of AI agents, AI frameworks, SDK clients, or MCP servers.
Falsepositives: Approved development, testing, or data science workflows.

rule.description: AI or MCP tooling launched by package runner from high-risk user path
rule.info: Detects AI or MCP package-runner activity from Downloads, Desktop, or Temp working directories.
Falsepositives: Approved testing or demos from temporary folders.

rule.description: AI or MCP tool referenced from portable user path in command line
rule.info: Detects command lines that reference AI or MCP tooling from portable or user-controlled paths, even when the parent process is a shell or runtime.
Falsepositives: Approved scripts in developer workspaces.
